document.title: Massachusetts 10th edition: residential R313 sprinkler amendments only
document.publisher: Massachusetts Board of Building Regulations and Standards

authorization.basis: Publicly promulgated Massachusetts regulation, 780 CMR. State amendment text only; no full incorporated ICC or NFPA book. Mass.gov labels its PDF an unofficial copy; official copies are obtained from the Secretary of the Commonwealth. Selected pages visually checked 2026-10-07. Extraction and coverage notes are in docs/boston-source-findings.md.
